text:
mike-p: Quick sync — GKE Marketplace team notified partners that the addon will stop serving legacy /v1 SDK endpoints. They want a clear compatibility window and a shim option. Can we hammer out timing and rollback plans? @jordi @sarah

jordi: I put a rough plan together: 8-week deprecation timeline with a 4-week shim overlap. Marketplace review adds ~2 weeks for listing updates. Need eng confirmation on effort and risk.

sarah: 8 weeks seems reasonable from product/partners side. We should send partner comms on day 0, publish migration docs by end of week 1, and schedule office hours in week 3.

evan: Eng notes — runtime shim is doable. Proposed config flag: `REDWOOD_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHIM=true`. Shim will translate old /v1 calls to /v2 behavior. Default will flip off after the 4-week overlap unless enterprise opts in.

jordi: SDK implications: we should ship a semver major (v2) that removes v1 endpoint calls. Recommend the new SDK includes a transient fallback to check for shim presence, e.g., try /v2 then fallback to /v1 if 404 and shim header present.

mike-p: Good. We need a short migration snippet to share with partners and a partner-facing FAQ. Also confirm who will update the marketplace listing and handle the review notes.

anna-docs: I can own docs + sample migration patch. Draft snippet for partners:```yaml
# client config example
redwood:
  api_version: "v2"
  fallback_to_shim: true
```I'll add a subsection on expected latency differences and a checklist.

evan: Rollout plan from infra: canary to 5% of addon installs for 72h, monitor 5xxs, median latency, and token cost delta. If anything regresses past thresholds, we rollback to full legacy behavior via a deploy flag.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: marketplace-addon-shim v1.0 -> canary start 2023-05-10T10:00Z (automated monitoring enabled).

mike-p: Note — marketplace update needs new screenshots and SKU metadata; that usually adds ~5 business days in the review queue. I'll coordinate with the marketplace PM.

sarah: We'll prepare partner comms template (why, timeline, how to test, how to opt-in to extended grace). Also planning office hours week 3 for live migrations.

jordi: One engineering ask: add CI lint/e2e gate that fails if any internal integration still calls v1 endpoints, so we don't ship regressions.

evan: ETA on shim PR: 5 business days. I'll open the PR, tag @anna-docs for the docs + migration snippet, and @deploy-bot for rollout.

mike-p: Great. Final questions: is there any reason to extend the shim beyond 4 weeks for general customers? Product suggests an enterprise opt-out of an additional 60-day grace window via config.

sarah: Confirmed — enterprise customers can request `legacy_grace=true` for 60 extra days; we'll gate that through account team and billing. Communicate that clearly in the FAQ.

mike-p: Perfect. I'll compile this into the partner comms draft and ping the partner contacts EOD. If anyone sees missing pieces (legal, billing, marketplace assets), flag them here. :thumbsup:
